speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Good morning, Leonard. Yeah, we're going to have to stop by Pottery Barn on the way to work, I bought these Star Wars sheets but they turned out to be much too stimulating to be compatible with a good night's sleep. I don't like the way Darth Vader stares at me.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Uh-huh.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I'm not going to work.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, just because your career's been stagnant for a few years, that's no reason to give up.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon, I was up all night using the new free-electron laser for my X-ray diffraction experiment.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Did the laser accidentally burn out your retinas?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Then you can drive. Let's go.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Didn't I tell you I'd be working nights, and that you'd have to make other arrangements. And?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You did. I didn't. Let's go.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Goodnight, Sheldon.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: But how am I going to get to work? I can't take the bus any more. They don't have seatbelts. And they won't let you lash yourself to the seat with bungee cords.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Take the bus.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: You tried to lash yourself to the seat with bungee cords?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I didn't try, I succeeded. For some reason it alarmed the other passengers and I was asked to de-bus.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, you're a big boy, you'll figure it out.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Don't talk to me like I'm a child. Now, take me to return my star wars sheets! Penny, Penny, Penny...

speaker: penny
text: Sheldon, what is it?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Leonard's asleep.

speaker: penny
text: Thanks for the update

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No, wait. You have to drive me to work.

speaker: penny
text: Yeah, uh, I really don't think I do.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: But I don't drive, and I can't take the bus.

speaker: penny
text: Yeah, honey, you'll be fine as long as you don't do that bungee cord thing, okay?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Penny. Didn't you recently state that you and I are friends?

speaker: penny
text: Yes, Sheldon, we are friends.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Then I hereby invoke what I'm given to understand is an integral part of the implied covenant of friendship.
